python_code:
async def act(page):
    # Select 'Processing' in the status combobox to filter orders
    status_combobox = page.get_by_role('combobox').filter(has=page.get_by_role('cell', name='Processing'))
    await status_combobox.select_option('Processing')
    # Click the 'Search' button to apply the filter
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Search').click()
    # Wait for the page to load after applying the filter
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Retrieve the raw HTML of the orders table without any processing
    orders_table_html = await page.inner_html('table')
    return orders_table_html
